verses: I also saw the soul of a man whom they gave excrement and dead refuse and corruption to eat; and the demons ever beat him with stones and axes.
And I asked thus: 'What sin was committed by this body, whose soul suffers so severe a punishment?'

Srosh the pious, and Adar the angel, said thus: 'This is the soul of that wicked darwand man who was at the warm baths which many have frequented, and he carried their bodily refuse and dead matter to water and fire and earth; and the pious went in, and came out wicked i.e. darwand, impure.
